name: Immersive ChemLab - Ion Chromatography
summary:
Step inside a fully immersive analytical chemistry laboratory and learn to operate real ion chromatography instrumentation across the 4 modules — hands-on, without ever setting foot in a lab.

Designed for third-level undergraduate chemistry students, this VR experience guides learners through the complete analytical workflow: exploring instrumentation and its components, initialising the system and software, performing sample injection, and generating and interpreting chromatographic data.
